summary: The address bar where you type or see the current website's URL.
description: The browser's address bar input. Despite the moz- prefix (which predates the modern naming convention) this is a classic custom element with no JSDoc/Lit conventions; it wraps a plain <input> and drives search mode, autofill, and the results view (UrlbarView). UrlbarInput.mjs now only registers the moz-urlbar tag on a thin subclass (`export class UrlbarInput extends UrlbarInputBase {}`); the real implementation lives in the sibling UrlbarInputBase.mjs.

attributes.name: sap-name
attributes.description: Which surface this instance represents: "urlbar", "searchbar", or "smartbar"; backed by the sapName getter.

attributes.name: pageproxystate
attributes.description: "valid" when the displayed value matches the loaded page URL, "invalid" once the user starts typing/searching; gates autofill and search-mode behavior.

attributes.name: open
attributes.description: Observed attribute; reflects whether the results view (breakout/expanded state) is open. Toggled by UrlbarView.

attributes.name: breakout
attributes.description: Reflects the expanded/breakout layout state used when the results panel is showing.

attributes.name: focused
attributes.description: Reflects focus state on the container for styling purposes.

attributes.name: actiontype
attributes.description: Reflects a result's action type when autofilling a suggestion.

attributes.name: textoverflow
attributes.description: "start" or "end"; controls which side the value text-overflow fade appears on.

attributes.name: searchmode
attributes.description: Present while a search mode (e.g. a specific search engine or local scope) is active; removed on exit.

attributes.name: persistsearchterms
attributes.description: Controls whether search terms persist in the input after a search is performed.

attributes.name: action-override
attributes.description: Internal override used to force a specific action/result type.

attributes.name: readOnly
attributes.description: JS getter/setter property (not a plain attribute) that reflects to the underlying input field's readOnly state.

slots.name: remote-control-box
slots.description: Bespoke slot (via urlbar-slot="remote-control-box" on a child, moved by #populateSlots) shown when the browser is remotely controlled.

slots.name: site-info
slots.description: Bespoke slot for site identity/permissions info shown before the input.

slots.name: revert-button
slots.description: Bespoke slot for the button that reverts a typed value back to the page URL.

slots.name: page-actions
slots.description: Bespoke slot for page action buttons shown after the input (e.g. star/bookmark, extensions).

slots.name: search-one-offs
slots.description: Bespoke slot for the one-off search engine buttons shown in the results view.

events.name: beforefocus
events.description: Cancelable CustomEvent fired before focus() proceeds.

events.name: beforeselect
events.description: Cancelable CustomEvent fired before select()/setSelectionRange() proceeds.

events.name: SetURI
events.description: Bubbling CustomEvent fired on the input field after setURI() updates the displayed value.

events.name: ValueChange
events.description: Legacy accessibility event fired when the value changes.

events.name: searchmodechanged
events.description: Bubbling Event fired whenever a search mode is entered or exited.

cssProperties.name: --urlbar-background-color-focus
cssProperties.description: Background color when the urlbar is focused.

cssProperties.name: --urlbar-box-background-color
cssProperties.description: Background color of the input box.

cssProperties.name: --urlbar-box-background-color-hover
cssProperties.description: Background color of the input box on hover.

cssProperties.name: --urlbar-box-background-color-active
cssProperties.description: Background color of the input box while active.

cssProperties.name: --urlbar-box-background-color-focus
cssProperties.description: Background color of the input box while focused.

cssProperties.name: --urlbar-box-text-color
cssProperties.description: Text color inside the input box.

cssProperties.name: --urlbar-box-text-color-hover
cssProperties.description: Text color inside the input box on hover.

cssProperties.name: --urlbar-icon-fill-opacity
cssProperties.description: Fill opacity applied to icons inside the urlbar.
